policies.title: Terms of booking
policies.summary: How a booking is made, paid for and changed when you book with us directly.

body.text: [Placeholder] These terms apply to every booking made through this website. They sit alongside our cancellation policy and privacy policy, which are linked below.
Making a booking
[Placeholder] When you submit a booking we hold your chosen room for a short time while you pay. A booking is only confirmed once you receive a confirmation email from us.

items: [Placeholder] You must give accurate guest details, including a name that matches a valid photo ID.
[Placeholder] The lead guest must be at least 18 years old.
[Placeholder] Prices are shown before any payment and the server total is the amount you pay.

body.text: Payment
[Placeholder] You can pay online, by bank transfer, or at the hotel depending on the rate you choose. Card payments are handled by our payment provider; we never store your card number.
Changes and cancellations
[Placeholder] You can change or cancel a booking through the manage booking page or by contacting us. What you owe or get back depends on the cancellation policy shown on your booking.
Questions
[Placeholder] If anything here is unclear, contact us before you book and we will explain it.

policies.metaDescription: [Placeholder] The terms that apply when you book a room or apartment with us directly, including payment and changes.

policies.title: Privacy policy
policies.summary: What we do with your personal details, who we share them with, and the choices you have.

body.text: [Placeholder] This policy explains how we collect and use your personal data when you contact us or book a stay. It must be reviewed against the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA) before launch and kept up to date.
What we collect

items: [Placeholder] Your name, email address and phone number.
[Placeholder] Your stay details: dates, number of guests and room type.
[Placeholder] Payment information is handled by our payment provider and is not stored by us.

body.text: Why we use it
[Placeholder] We use your details to manage your booking, contact you about your stay, reply to your enquiries and meet legal obligations. We do not sell your data.
Who we share it with
[Placeholder] We share what is necessary with our payment provider and email provider to complete your booking and send confirmations. We never share more than is needed.
How long we keep it
[Placeholder] We keep booking records for as long as needed for accounting and legal purposes, then delete or anonymise them.
Your rights
[Placeholder] You can ask us to access, correct or delete your personal data, and you can object to how we use it. Contact us to make a request.

policies.metaDescription: [Placeholder] How we collect, use and protect your personal data when you book or contact us, and the rights you have.

policies.title: Cancellation policy
policies.summary: When a cancellation is free, what you get back, and what happens if you do not arrive.

body.text: [Placeholder] The cancellation terms shown on your booking at the time you booked always apply to that booking. The summary below explains how our usual policy works.
Free cancellation
[Placeholder] You can cancel free of charge up to the free-cancellation window before your arrival date. The exact deadline is shown on your booking confirmation.
After the free window
[Placeholder] Once the free window has passed, a percentage of the stay is charged. The percentage and how a refund is worked out are shown on your booking when you manage it.
Refunds
[Placeholder] Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method. How long it takes depends on your bank or card provider.
If you do not arrive
[Placeholder] If you do not check in and have not cancelled, the booking is treated as a no-show and may be charged in full.
How to cancel
[Placeholder] You can cancel through the manage booking page or by contacting us with your booking reference.

policies.metaDescription: [Placeholder] When cancellation is free, what a refund covers, and what to do if your plans change.
